exposure: mothers inability to read and write
more than 28 weeks of gestation at the first visit of antenatal care
mothers whose gestational age was 16 to 28 weeks at the first antenatal care visit
cohort: The study participants were women attending intrapartum care in Amhara region referral hospitals, comprising 270 cases with obstructed labor and 540 controls without obstructed labor.
finding: Several obstetric, service-related, and system factors, including maternal literacy, access to healthcare, gestational age at first antenatal care visit, and gestational age at admission, were identified as significant determinants of obstructed labor.
gest_age: 16 to 28 weeks (at first antenatal care visit), >28 weeks (at first antenatal care visit), 37 to 42 weeks (at admission), >42 weeks (at admission)
